scope: All 12 preselected UK items and all 12 saved seven-day development origins; independent single-period simulations, stock resets each origin; order arrives at period start, no midweek replenishment/backlog/substitution, identical unit storage slots, pack size 6 assumed.
uncertainty: Eight common past 7-day blocks, each SKU scaled by forecast / past-eight-week mean; zero mean uses forecast in every scenario. Equal weights, no coverage claim. Only past 56 days used.
resources: Initial stock=floor(0.25*past-eight-week mean); unit purchase cost=max(1,ceil(100*0.6*historical transaction median retail price)) pence. Budget=floor(ratio*sum(cost*max(past mean-initial,0))). Capacity=max(sum(initial),floor(ratio*sum(past mean))); holds initial stock plus all arriving units. Resources identical across forecast models.
objective: purchase spending + mean_s[0.1*purchase_cost*leftover_s + shortage_ratio*retail_price*shortage_s]. No sales revenue, salvage, overhead or causal profit claim; opening stock cost sunk. Budget and inventory capacity hard constraints, pack quantities nonnegative integers.
policies: point: ceil(max(forecast-initial,0)/pack); buffer: ceil(max(forecast+scenario_population_std-initial,0)/pack). Both scaled to budget/capacity, floor then add feasible packs in descending target-pack deficit order with item-ID tie break. MILP minimizes the same eight-scenario cost; report solver status/gap, never silently fall back.
evaluation: Freeze all inputs and orders before attaching saved actuals. Reuse known development outcomes and a LightGBM configuration selected on these windows: not an independent test. Costs and stock are assumptions; recorded sales are demand proxies and may be censored by unknown stockouts. Score every origin, report regressions, compare model and policy separately. No retuning from outcomes.
